We experiment with four different LLMs as the LLM evaluator in CODEJUDGE, including GPT-3.5, CodeLlama-Instruct (34B), Llama-3-Instruct (8B), and Llama-3-Instruct (70B). For GPT-3.5, we used the GPT-3.5-Turbo-1106 API. For other models, we run them locally on eight A100-80GB GPUs. Since the cost of prompting GPT-3.5 is high, we only ran the experiments with GPT-3.5 once and set the temperature to 0 and top_p to 1 to obtain consistent outputs. For other models, we set the temperature to 0.4 and top_p to 0.9. We repeat the experiments three times to account for the randomness in model inference.
